```typescript title="TypeScript"

  const options: ConversionOptions = { includeDocumentStructure: true };
  const result = convert("<p>Items:</p><ul><li>Alpha</li><li>Beta</li><li>Gamma</li></ul>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
```
